claims.text: Many reviewers say the mitt effectively removes old self-tanner and leaves skin smooth and soft.
Several reviewers find the material thin and prone to tearing or ripping after only a few uses.
Some reviewers were disappointed that the product does not include any exfoliating wash or product despite the packaging and images suggesting otherwise.
Multiple reviewers praise the texture as effective without being too rough, suitable even for sensitive skin.
A few reviewers describe the fabric as scratchy and cheap-feeling.
